subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` hooks gain a permanent public `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract with caller-owned deferred execution?
rationale: This adds a shipped plugin API and defines cross-runtime session lifecycle semantics; implementation correctness alone cannot decide whether OpenClaw should support that public capability permanently.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped API
options.body: Approve the current-session, reason-only API after the unrelated auto-reset and memory-threshold changes are removed and exact-head lifecycle proof is supplied.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Withhold the public hook method and provide an internal or owner-specific compaction recovery seam instead.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or substantially redesign the PR until a narrower session-lifecycle contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped API
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session, reason-only API after the unrelated auto-reset and memory-threshold changes are removed and exact-head lifecycle proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The available ownership and history signals most directly connect this person to compaction and context-engine lifecycle behavior.
